issues.title: No print settings for the load-path parts: with slicer defaults the piston and saddle are overstressed
issues.evidence: grep infill/walls over README, BOM, plates.txt, export_prints.py: none; the 3MFs hold only 3D/3dmodel.model (no Metadata settings). head_a8.py 7: with 2 walls + 15 % infill, I_eff 5224 vs 15358 solid, so the piston mouth sees 133 MPa at 600 N and 67 at 300 N; the walls reach 50 MPa at a 226 N lean. Saddle across layers 19.7 MPa vs limit 15 (head_a8.py 6). Rows a8R piston default print 133 > 47.5, saddle 19.7 > 15 (cadcheck_review.json)
issues.fix: Specify per-part settings in BOM/plates and embed them in the 3MF as per-object overrides: piston, cartridge, washers, setting plug at 100 % infill (or at least 6 walls with 40 % gyroid: piston 67 MPa at 600 N is still too high, so 100 %), fins and trays 4 walls/25 %. Add a 'Print settings' column to the BOM printed-parts table and re-run the piston/saddle rows with the stated settings. About 30 min, no reprint if done before printing

issues.title: Right amp's Qwiic jumper tethers the two tray halves before they are hung separately, with 7 mm of slack
issues.evidence: cables row CAB_Amp_to_ESP32_R path_len 142.8, lead 150. README step 6 plugs it into the ESP32 header in tray L on the bench; step 10 hangs each tray-and-fin half separately; row a8R jumper 142.8 > 130 (cadcheck_review.json)
issues.fix: Move the right jumper to a new step 10b (after both halves are bolted, before the cover), and either buy a 200 mm Qwiic-to-female cable or move amp R 40 mm inboard (x 47-73) so the route is about 100 mm. Add it to assembly_order as its own step. 20 min of text/CAD

issues.title: Friction shunt during a 600 N single-grip lean is 12-20 N, over the 10 N dead band
issues.evidence: head_a8.py 5: flattened-crown land half width 0.26-0.32 (elliptical plastic contact) to 0.46 (designer, upper bound); shunt 11.9-19.6 N while 738 N rests on the saddle; 4.0-7.4 N on a later 300 N lean
issues.fix: Firmware: hold the dead band at max(10 N, 0.03 x |lean|) using a lean estimate, or ignore push below 20 N when the push-pull and the opposite grip disagree; or mechanically make the crown R0.6 on a 2 mm PETG insert. Bench test with 30 kg hung on one grip

issues.title: Piston's 45 deg step at y 141 carries 59-68 MPa at a 600 N lean (Kt 1.3-1.5) against the claimed x1.67
issues.evidence: head_a8.py 7: nominal 45.6 MPa; row a8R step Kt 1.4: 63.9 > 47.5
